subject: Final approval: BrightPath success story (quote + redlines)
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Lydia Park <lydia.park@brightpath.com>, Carlos Reyes <c.reyes@brightpath.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-09-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Draft: BrightPath success story — initial for your review

Lydia / Carlos,

Thanks again for partnering with us on this customer spotlight. Attached is the first draft (doc + figures) that Marketing drafted based on our interviews last month. Key asks:

- Please review factual sections (metrics, timeline, product names).
- Approve or edit the proposed short quote attributed to BrightPath’s Head of ML.
- Any redlines from legal — call them out inline or send a marked PDF.

Attachments: BrightPath-success-story-draft-1.docx, figures-usage.png

High level claims called out in the draft: 45% reduction in inference cost, 2.3x throughput improvement at peak, and under-50ms median latency on key routes after integrating Redwood. If any of those are off or you want them anonymized, flag below.

We’re hoping for a quick turnaround (one week) so Marketing can schedule the publish for Oct.

Thanks,
Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.com

From: Lydia Park <lydia.park@brightpath.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Cc: Carlos Reyes <c.reyes@brightpath.com>, BrightPath Legal <legal@brightpath.com>
Date: 2025-09-16T11:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft: BrightPath success story — initial for your review

Thanks Rishi — appreciate the quick turnaround. A few notes from our side after a fast pass (inline below).

- The 2.3x throughput claim is fine if that refers to end-to-end batch throughput on our peak job (Sept run). Please add a short parenthetical: (measured on peak batch jobs, Sept 2025).
- Please remove the exact TPS figure in the second para — legal prefers anonymized performance numbers in public materials.
- The “45% reduction in inference cost” sounds close; Carlos will confirm the final number.
- We’d like the quote to avoid naming a specific engineer. Can the quote be attributed to: "Head of ML, BrightPath Logistics" instead of using my name?

Legal also flagged the sentence on data residency that states data was kept in our US region — they want that removed unless we list the specific controls. I’ll attach any legal redlines later today.

I can review a revised draft by Friday.

— Lydia
Lydia Park
Head of ML, BrightPath Logistics
lydia.park@brightpath.com

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-09-17T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Draft: BrightPath success story — initial for your review

Forwarding Lydia’s notes — tagging Dev for product/metrics confirmation and Marissa for copy updates.

On Tue, Sep 16, 2025 at 11:08 AM Lydia Park <lydia.park@brightpath.com> wrote:
> Thanks Rishi — appreciate the quick turnaround. A few notes from our side after a fast pass (inline below).
> ...

Dev — can you: 
1) Confirm the 45% cost reduction number (or provide the corrected percent).
2) Send a short clarifying parenthetical for the throughput claim (how we measured it).
3) Confirm whether we can keep the US-region phrasing for data residency or if we should remove it.

If you send the numbers I’ll ask Marissa to fold them into a clean draft and push back to Lydia for sign-off.

Thanks,
Monica
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-09-18T14:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Draft: BrightPath success story — initial for your review

Hey team — quick facts from the serving side after checking telemetry and billing:

- Cost reduction: 42% (aggregate inference spend reduction across September vs June baseline) — rounding to ~42% in copy is safe.
- Throughput parenthetical: (measured on BrightPath peak batch jobs; comparison vs pre-Redwood single-GPU baseline).
- Latency: median per-request latency on our critical route is ~48ms after optimizations; if you prefer anonymized language, suggest: "median latency under 50ms on key inference routes".
- Data residency: BrightPath data was kept in their US VPC region; however legal prefers not to call out regions publicly without a controls paragraph. Recommend removing the region phrase and adding: "BrightPath retained control over data residency and encryption; see appendix for details."

Attaching a small CSV with the summarized numbers: latency-table.csv

— Dev
Dev Patel
Senior Software Engineer, Serving Runtime
dev_patel@redwood.com

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Lydia Park <lydia.park@brightpath.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-09-20T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Updated draft attached — request for sign-off and publish date

Lydia,

Thanks for the checks. We incorporated your legal preference to anonymize TPS and removed the explicit region wording. Dev supplied the final metrics and Marissa updated the copy. The revised draft is attached and the key edits are summarized below:

- Cost reduction updated to "~42% reduction in inference spend"
- Throughput line now reads: "2.3x batch throughput improvement (measured on peak jobs)"
- Latency phrasing: "median latency under 50ms on key inference routes"
- Quote attributed to: "Head of ML, BrightPath Logistics"
- Data residency sentence removed; replaced with a short line pointing to an appendix for controls.

Attachments: BrightPath-success-story-draft-1.docx (v2), figures-usage.png

If this looks good, are we approved to publish the piece on Oct 6? If Legal still needs to redline, feel free to send it back — we can hold the publish. Also including a DocuSign link for a short release if you’d like a signature: https://redwood-inference.example.com/docusign/BP-98321

Appreciate it —
Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference

From: Lydia Park <lydia.park@brightpath.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Cc: Carlos Reyes <c.reyes@brightpath.com>, BrightPath Legal <legal@brightpath.com>
Date: 2025-09-22T16:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Updated draft attached — request for sign-off and publish date

Rishi / team — this looks great. Two final minor asks:

1) Please replace the TPS sentence with the anonymized phrasing you suggested (under 50ms).
2) Remove the appendix link placeholder — our legal will provide a short one-paragraph controls blurb by early next week; if not provided, please omit the appendix reference.

We approve the piece for publish on Oct 6 and grant permission to use the quote attributed to "Head of ML, BrightPath Logistics". No signature via DocuSign required from our side — this email serves as approval.

Thanks to everyone who moved quickly here — excited to see this live.

Best,
Lydia Park
Head of ML, BrightPath Logistics
